defects.title: System discovery still exposes and normalizes raw `nostr.relays` outside the approved sidecar-first contract
evidence: internal/adapters/nostr/projector.go no longer populates `nostr.relays` and omits the field from system discovery responses.
web/src/lib/stores/controlplane.svelte.js resolves browser bootstrap only from `browser_relays` and `sidecar_url`.
internal/api/handlers/system_test.go now asserts raw `nostr.relays` is absent in both sidecar-enabled and sidecar-disabled responses.
web/tests/unit/controlplane-store.test.js now proves raw `nostr.relays` is ignored as browser bootstrap input.
HITL-SYSTEM_DISCOVERY_RELAY_BOOTSTRAP-001 classified direct `nostr.relays` exposure as FIX/REMOVE rather than intended behavior.
defects.suspected_root_cause: Resolved: legacy sidecar-disabled compatibility behavior was removed from both the handler and browser relay-resolution helper.

defects.title: Sidecar-first public bootstrap contract is only partially covered in projector tests
evidence: internal/api/handlers/system_test.go now exercises a deterministic service-key-backed sidecar configuration.
The updated projector test asserts `browser_relays`, `sidecar_url`, `relay_read_models`, derived `service_pubkey`, and absence of raw `nostr.relays` in the approved sidecar-first success case.
test_matrix.json now marks SDRB-T-001 as passing.
defects.suspected_root_cause: Resolved: the handler contract suite now covers the approved sidecar-first success path instead of the older partial assertion set.

defects.title: Fail-closed browser bootstrap negatives for missing capability and missing browser bootstrap URLs are untested
evidence: web/tests/unit/controlplane-store.test.js now proves deterministic failure when `relay_read_models` is false.
web/tests/unit/controlplane-store.test.js now proves deterministic failure when no `browser_relays` or `sidecar_url` are advertised.
Full web verification suite passed with these new cases.
defects.suspected_root_cause: Resolved: the control-plane bootstrap unit suite now covers the full approved fail-closed discovery branches.

defects.title: Operator discovery fallback lacks a required negative test for empty browser bootstrap advertisement
evidence: cmd/cli/operator_nostr_test.go now exercises the discovery-empty branch and asserts the deterministic `no operator relays discovered` failure.
go test ./cmd/cli passed with the new negative branch.
defects.suspected_root_cause: Resolved: the CLI precedence suite now covers discovery fallback failure when Nostr discovery advertises no browser bootstrap URLs.

defects.title: Encrypted capability gating and multi-consumer discovery coherence are not fully proven against the approved contract
evidence: web/tests/unit/encrypted-controlplane.test.js now proves encrypted capability requires explicit encrypted indicators and is not implied by public bootstrap fields alone.

test/fixtures/system_discovery_sidecar_first.json is shared by `web/tests/unit/controlplane-store.test.js`, `web/tests/unit/encrypted-controlplane.test.js`, and `cmd/cli/operator_nostr_test.go` to prove one canonical payload satisfies browser bootstrap, encrypted capability gating, and CLI discovery.
go and web verification suites passed using the shared canonical fixture and existing relay-backed smoke coverage.
defects.suspected_root_cause: Resolved: the shared discovery contract is now proven across the browser bootstrap helper, encrypted capability helper, and operator CLI discovery path using one canonical fixture.
